title.zh-TW: 台灣多家銀行爆發網銀異常轉帳：從永豐「中台」供應商漏洞到 4 銀行深夜通過雙重驗證盜轉爭議
title.en: Taiwan online banking transfer incidents: from Bank SinoPac's middle-office vendor flaw to overnight 2FA transfer disputes at four banks

summary.zh-TW: 11 月台灣金融圈接連發生兩波網銀異常轉帳事件：月初永豐銀行因新版網銀供應商「中台」漏洞遭轉出 4,176 萬元；月中旬北富銀、華南、玉山、中信又傳出民眾熟睡時遭連續轉帳，但後端顯示皆正常通過雙重驗證（2FA/OTP）。同期美國摩根大通也因內部軟體漏洞導致跨行與 Zelle 轉帳延遲。這一系列事件直指金融軟體架構的兩大痛點：中台供應鏈資安與端點遭控下的驗證信任邊界。
summary.en: Two waves of abnormal online-banking transfers hit Taiwan in November: early in the month, hackers exploited a third-party middle-office flaw at Bank SinoPac to move NT$41.76M; mid-month, customers at four major banks reported overnight transfers while asleep that nevertheless passed device binding and 2FA/OTP checks. Around the same time, a software bug at JPMorgan Chase delayed online banking and Zelle transfers in the US. Together they spotlight two critical engineering challenges: middle-office supply-chain security and authentication trust when user endpoints are compromised.

facts.zh-TW: 第一波（系統中台漏洞）：11/3 永豐銀行爆發大規模異常轉帳，共 418 名客戶、427 筆交易遭不明轉出，總金額 4,176 萬元，全數匯入台北富邦銀行同一指定帳戶（隨即遭凍結）。永豐證實為外部駭客利用「新網銀交易系統」國外供應商的安全設定原生瑕疵發動隨機試誤攻擊，當日即下架新版 App 並全額代墊退還客戶款項與手續費。
facts.en: Wave 1 (middle-office vendor flaw): On Nov 3, 418 Bank SinoPac customers saw 427 unauthorized transfers totaling NT$41.76M routed to a single Taipei Fubon Bank account, which was frozen. SinoPac confirmed hackers exploited a security configuration flaw in a foreign vendor's new online-banking system, took down the new app, and refunded all affected customers the same day.

facts.zh-TW: 金管會指出，過去銀行資安多重兵防守「前台」與「後台（核心帳務）」，永豐案漏洞卻出在介於兩者之間的「中台」，已通令全體金融機構針對中台與委外供應鏈展開全面資安清查。
facts.en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) noted that banks traditionally focus defenses on front-end interfaces and back-end core ledgers, whereas the SinoPac flaw sat in the middle office; it ordered all financial institutions to audit middle-office and third-party supply-chain security.

facts.zh-TW: 第二波（通過雙重驗證的深夜轉帳）：11 月中旬起，多位民眾反映在半夜熟睡時遭連續轉出款項至電子支付或電商平台（如北富銀有客戶遭連轉 17 筆共約 23 萬元）。金管會 11/19 公布，共中信、玉山、北富銀、華南 4 家銀行通報「重大偶發事件」，合計 5 件、5 名客戶，金額共 56 萬 6,512 元。
facts.en: Wave 2 (overnight transfers passing 2FA): In mid-November, depositors reported consecutive overnight transfers to e-payment platforms while asleep (including 17 transfers totaling about NT$230,000 from one Taipei Fubon account). On Nov 19 the FSC confirmed four banks—CTBC, E.SUN, Taipei Fubon and Hua Nan—reported five major incidental events affecting five customers for a total of NT$566,512.

facts.zh-TW: 金管會與 4 家銀行盤查後強調，第二波個案的銀行端系統並未遭駭、亦無資安漏洞，所有爭議交易均由客戶原綁定行動裝置發起，並完整通過雙重身分驗證（含 OTP 或生物辨識），研判可能與用戶手機（多為 Android）遭植入惡意程式或釣魚攔截有關，已交由檢警數位鑑識。
facts.en: The FSC and the four banks stated that in the second wave, bank servers were not breached: every disputed transaction originated from the customer's bound mobile device and passed two-factor authentication (including OTP or biometrics), pointing to possible malware or phishing on user devices (mostly Android); police forensics are underway.

facts.zh-TW: 國際對照：美東時間 11/16，美國最大銀行摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）亦因本地端硬體系統的軟體錯誤（非網路攻擊）導致網銀交易處理緩慢，並外溢影響美國銀行、富國銀行及 Zelle 跨行即時轉帳延遲，於當晚修復。
facts.en: International parallel: On Nov 16 ET, a software bug in an on-premises hardware system at JPMorgan Chase (not a cyberattack) slowed transaction processing and caused spillover delays across Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Zelle transfers before being fixed that evening.

work.zh-TW: 中台與微服務邊界防護：金融與企業系統導入第三方中台或 API 閘道時，不能假設「內部中介層已受前台保護」，須對中台服務實施零信任驗證、參數校驗與速率限制（Rate Limiting），防止如永豐案針對身分證字號首碼的批次試誤攻擊。
work.en: Middle-office and API boundary hardening: When integrating third-party middle-office components or API gateways, teams cannot assume the middle layer is protected by the front end; enforce zero-trust auth, strict input validation and rate limiting against enumeration attacks.

work.zh-TW: 從「認證通過即放行」轉向「交易行為風控」：當用戶端手機遭惡意程式控制時，傳統簡訊 OTP 與裝置綁定可能被本機木馬直接讀取或代填。支付與轉帳系統應在驗證之外加入行為風控（例如：深夜時段短時間內連續多筆轉入電子支付帳戶時，觸發冷卻期、降額或要求額外人臉／FIDO 硬體金鑰驗證）。
work.en: Move beyond "2FA passed" to behavioral risk controls: When a user's phone is compromised by local malware, SMS OTPs and device tokens can be intercepted on-device. Payment systems should layer behavioral velocity checks—such as throttling or requiring FIDO/biometric step-up when rapid consecutive transfers to e-wallets occur overnight.

work.zh-TW: 高流量時段的交易韌性：永豐銀行於 11/6 台股交割與現增繳款高峰日亦曾出現短暫跨行轉帳壅塞；設計帳務與轉帳系統時，應針對交割日尖峰配置佇列削峰與退避重試機制。
work.en: Peak-load resilience: Bank SinoPac also saw brief transfer congestion on Nov 6 during heavy stock-settlement traffic; payment pipelines should use queue leveling and backoff retries for settlement spikes.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 金管會要求全體銀行於通報重大偶發後 7 個營業日內提交詳細調查報告，並召集數十家金融機構資安長檢討中台架構與委外供應商盡職調查。
securityFacts.en: The FSC required detailed investigation reports within seven business days of major-incident filings and convened CISOs across Taiwanese financial institutions to review middle-office security and vendor due diligence.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 金管會提醒民眾，切勿點擊不明簡訊連結或安裝來路不明的應用程式（如部分偽裝成 AI 短影音、短劇或工具的側載 APK），避免手機簡訊與螢幕權限遭惡意程式接管。
securityFacts.en: The FSC advised users not to click unknown SMS links or sideload untrusted apps (such as fake AI short-video or drama APKs) that request SMS or accessibility permissions.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: Android 銀行木馬常濫用「無障礙服務（Accessibility Service）」與簡訊讀取權限，在使用者睡眠或螢幕變暗時自動點擊網銀 App 並讀取 OTP 簡訊完成轉帳。
securityPatterns.en: Android banking trojans frequently abuse Accessibility Services and SMS permissions to automate banking app taps and read OTP messages while the user is asleep.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 轉帳異常新聞發酵期間，常出現假冒銀行客服或金管會名義的釣魚簡訊，宣稱「您的帳戶疑似遭異常轉帳，請點此解除綁定或重設安全密碼」。
securityPatterns.en: During high-profile transfer incidents, phishing SMS messages often impersonate bank support claiming "suspicious transfers detected on your account—click here to reset your security code."

views.zh-TW: 媒體關注焦點集中在金管會對銀行「中台」與委外供應鏈的全面清查要求，以及雙重驗證通過下銀行與存戶之間的舉證責任分攤。
views.en: Media coverage focused on the FSC's industry-wide audit of bank middle-office systems and vendor supply chains, as well as the burden of proof between banks and depositors when disputed transfers pass 2FA.

caveats.zh-TW: 金融股 11 月中下旬的股價波動同時受台股大盤修正、美國利率政策預期與外資部位調整影響，未有報導將單日股價跌幅直接歸因於上述網銀轉帳個案。
caveats.en: Taiwan financial stocks in mid-to-late November were also moved by broader market pullbacks, US rate expectations and foreign-investor flows; no reporting attributed the single-day stock drops directly to these transfer cases.

text.zh-TW: 永豐銀行新版網銀爆發異常轉帳，418 名客戶共 427 筆款項（合計 4,176 萬元）遭轉入北富銀同一帳戶；永豐緊急下架新版 App 並於當日全額代墊退還客戶。
text.en: Bank SinoPac's new online banking system suffered 427 unauthorized transfers across 418 accounts (NT$41.76M total) into a single Taipei Fubon account; SinoPac pulled the new app and refunded all customers the same day.

text.zh-TW: 永豐銀行董事長與總經理召開記者會致歉，證實為外部駭客利用國外供應商新網銀系統「中台」安全設定瑕疵發動攻擊；金管會通令全體金融機構全面檢視中台與供應鏈資安。
text.en: Bank SinoPac's chairman and president apologized at a press conference, confirming hackers exploited a middle-office configuration flaw in a foreign vendor's system; the FSC ordered all financial institutions to audit middle-office security.

text.zh-TW: 美國最大銀行摩根大通因內部硬體系統的軟體錯誤爆發網銀登入與交易延遲，並外溢導致 Zelle 跨行轉帳受阻，於當晚修復。
text.en: A software bug in an on-premises system at JPMorgan Chase caused online banking and Zelle transfer delays across the US before being resolved that evening.

text.zh-TW: 針對社群接連爆出民眾半夜遭連續轉帳，金管會證實共有中信、玉山、北富銀、華南 4 家銀行通報重大偶發事件（共 5 件、56 萬 6,512 元），初步清查銀行系統未遭駭且交易皆通過雙重驗證，交由檢警進行手機數位鑑識。
text.en: Following social-media reports of overnight transfers while depositors slept, the FSC confirmed four banks (CTBC, E.SUN, Taipei Fubon and Hua Nan) reported five major incidental events totaling NT$566,512; initial checks found no bank breach and confirmed all transactions passed 2FA, with police forensics ongoing.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 檢警對 4 家銀行個案的手機數位鑑識結果、金管會「中台」資安清查後續規範，以及各銀行是否針對深夜連續轉入電子支付加強風控機制。
nextWatch.en: Police digital-forensics findings on the five mobile devices, the FSC's follow-up rules from the middle-office security audit, and whether banks tighten velocity controls on overnight transfers to e-wallets.

topic.zh-TW: 深夜異常轉帳在「雙重驗證通過」下的原因與責任
topic.en: Cause and responsibility when overnight transfers pass 2FA

claim.zh-TW: 半夜熟睡期間並未操作手機，也未收到或輸入 OTP 驗證碼，帳戶卻遭連續多筆轉出至電子支付平台，質疑網銀防護失靈。
claim.en: Depositors say they were asleep, never touched their phones, and never received or entered an OTP code while multiple transfers drained funds into e-payment platforms.

claim.zh-TW: 後端紀錄顯示 5 起交易均由客戶原綁定行動裝置發起，並完整走完登入認證與雙重身分驗證（OTP 等）程序，銀行系統無漏洞或入侵跡象，不排除是用戶端手機遭惡意程式植入或釣魚攔截。
claim.en: The FSC and banks say backend logs show all five cases originated from the customer's bound device and completed login and 2FA/OTP verification, with no bank breach, pointing to possible malware or phishing on user phones.

verdict.zh-TW: 必須區分兩波不同事件：11/3 永豐案已確認為銀行端「中台供應商系統漏洞」並全額退還；11 月中旬 4 銀行共 5 件個案在伺服器端確實具備完整雙重驗證紀錄，真因需待檢警對受害者手機完成數位鑑識才能確認是否為端點木馬攔截簡訊與自動操作。
verdict.en: The two waves are distinct: the Nov 3 SinoPac incident was a confirmed bank-side middle-office vendor flaw and was refunded in full, whereas the mid-November five cases across four banks carry valid device and 2FA logs on the server side and await police mobile forensics to determine whether endpoint malware hijacked SMS and UI actions.

what.zh-TW: 永豐銀因中台供應商漏洞遭轉出 4,176 萬元；另 4 銀行通報 5 件深夜異常轉帳共 56.6 萬元（均通過雙重驗證）。
what.en: Bank SinoPac lost NT$41.76M to a middle-office vendor flaw (refunded); four other banks reported five overnight transfer cases totaling NT$566K that all passed 2FA.

impact.zh-TW: 凸顯銀行「中台」供應鏈防護缺口，以及用戶端手機若中毒、傳統簡訊 OTP 無法阻止自動轉帳的風險。
impact.en: Exposes gaps in middle-office vendor security and shows that SMS OTP alone cannot stop automated transfers if a user's phone is compromised.

action.zh-TW: 系統設計應補強中台驗證與深夜連續轉帳風控；個人應關閉非必要大額約定或調降非約定轉帳限額、不側載不明 App。
action.en: Engineers should harden middle-office APIs and add velocity controls for overnight transfers; users should lower non-designated transfer limits and avoid sideloaded apps.

title.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭任 Nvidia 執行長：董事會排除回鍋、財報首破千億美元後股價仍重挫
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO: board rules out return as stock slides despite $115.8B quarter

summary.zh-TW: AI 晶片龍頭最高領導人即刻離任。儘管 11/17 公布的第三季營收首度突破千億美元（1,158 億美元）且台積電高層親赴固樁，但董事會明確排除黃仁勳回鍋，加上治理與出口管制疑慮，Nvidia 股價在財報後連跌三日，11/20 單日重挫 14.01% 收 125.53 美元。
summary.en: The AI chip leader's chief executive left with immediate effect. Even after Q3 revenue topped $100B for the first time ($115.8B) on Nov 17 and TSMC's leadership visited Nvidia in person, the board explicitly ruled out reinstating Huang; combined with governance and export-control concerns, Nvidia shares fell for three straight sessions after earnings, plunging 14.01% on Nov 20 to $125.53.

facts.zh-TW: 黃仁勳於 11/12 辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效；資深財務長 Colette Kress 出任臨時執行長（同時兼任財務長）。
facts.en: Huang stepped down as president, CEO and director on Nov 12, effective immediately; longtime CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO while retaining her CFO duties.

facts.zh-TW: Harvey C. Jones 出任 Nvidia 首任董事會主席，並委託獵頭顧問公司 Heidrick & Struggles 從公司內外部遴選正式執行長人選。針對黃仁勳曾表達若董事會需要願意回歸，Jones 在財報會議中明確表示「董事會一致接受辭呈，無意恢復其執行長職務」。
facts.en: Harvey C. Jones became Nvidia's first board chair and engaged executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles to evaluate internal and external CEO candidates. After Huang indicated he would return if asked, Jones stated on the earnings call that the board unanimously accepted his resignation and has no intention of reinstating him.

facts.zh-TW: 過渡期首份財報表現強勁：11/17 盤後公布 2027 會計年度第三季營收達 1,158 億美元（年增 103%），資料中心營收 1,076 億美元，新一代 Vera Rubin 平台首季即貢獻近 200 億美元；第四季營收預估 1,300 億美元（±3%），並將下年度成長預期由 70% 上調至 75%，同時宣布加碼 1,500 億美元庫藏股回購。
facts.en: First post-transition earnings beat expectations: on Nov 17 Nvidia reported FY27 Q3 revenue of $115.8B (+103% YoY) and Data Center revenue of $107.6B, with the new Vera Rubin platform contributing nearly $20B in its first quarter. Q4 revenue was guided to $130B (±3%), next fiscal year growth was raised from 70% to 75%, and the board added $150B in share buybacks.

facts.zh-TW: 供應鏈固樁：臨時執行長 Colette Kress 在法說會透露，台積電（TSMC）領導團隊於當週親赴輝達辦公室全力參與協助，並點名矽品（日月光旗下）、京元電、景碩、欣興與鴻海等核心台廠合作與出貨動能無虞。
facts.en: Supply-chain reassurance: interim CEO Colette Kress noted on the earnings call that TSMC's leadership team visited Nvidia's offices in person that week to support operations, and highlighted continued momentum with Taiwanese partners including SPIL (ASE), KYEC, Kinsus, Unimicron and Foxconn.

facts.zh-TW: 辭任原因各媒體報導不一，本站不轉述未經證實的指控。
facts.en: Reported reasons vary across outlets; we don't repeat unverified allegations.

work.zh-TW: 產品路線圖與開發工具維持不變：Vera Rubin 平台已進入量產出貨，CUDA 與相關軟體生態系、授權條款均無變更公告。
work.en: Product roadmap and developer tools remain unchanged: Vera Rubin is shipping in volume, and no changes to CUDA, software ecosystems or licensing have been announced.

work.zh-TW: 後續觀察重點是 Heidrick & Struggles 主導的新任執行長遴選結果，以及新領導層對下一代架構研發節奏與雲端客戶配貨策略是否延續。
work.en: Key items to watch are the outcome of the Heidrick & Struggles CEO search and whether permanent leadership maintains the same architecture cadence and cloud allocation strategy.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大新聞發生後，常出現假冒新聞連結或「內幕消息」的釣魚信與詐騙投資訊息。
securityPatterns.en: Big news is routinely followed by phishing that poses as news links or "inside information", and by investment scams.

move.zh-TW: 一度跌逾 700 點，收漲 548 點

move.en: opened +1.46%, up over 1,200 points in early trade

basis.en: Nov 13 early trade, not a close

views.zh-TW: 中央社將台股 11/13 的走高描述為「短期利空出盡」的反應；但 11/17 財報發布後，儘管營收與財測雙超預期、盤後一度漲逾 3%，隔日（11/18）起仍出現「利多出盡（Sell the news）」賣壓。
views.en: CNA described Taiwan's Nov 13 rise as bad news being priced in; however, after the Nov 17 earnings beat sent shares up over 3% after hours, a "sell the news" reversal took hold starting Nov 18.

views.zh-TW: 中央社與風傳媒報導指出，董事會明確排除黃仁勳回鍋可能性，加上市場持續消化晶片出口管制擴大與相關監管調查等公司治理變數，使股價在財報後連跌三日（11/18 跌 2.89%、11/19 跌 3.30%、11/20 重挫 14.01%）。
views.en: CNA and Storm Media reported that the board's refusal to reinstate Huang, alongside ongoing export-control and regulatory scrutiny, weighed on the stock for three consecutive sessions after earnings (-2.89% on Nov 18, -3.30% on Nov 19 and -14.01% on Nov 20).

views.zh-TW: 自由財經報導，部分投資人資金轉向 AMD 與博通等 Nvidia 競爭對手。
views.en: Liberty Times Finance reported some investors rotating into Nvidia rivals AMD and Broadcom.

caveats.zh-TW: 11 月中下旬美股科技股同時面臨聯準會鷹派利率預期與高估值修正壓力，Nvidia 財報後的跌幅並非單一由人事異動造成。
caveats.en: US tech stocks also faced hawkish Fed rate expectations and valuation pullbacks in mid-to-late November, so Nvidia's post-earnings slide wasn't driven solely by the leadership change.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股 11/12 的下跌發生在正式宣布之前，當時市場已有相關人事傳聞，不能全部歸因於這次宣布。
caveats.en: Taiwan's Nov 12 drop came before the official announcement, while personnel rumors were already circulating, so it can't all be attributed to the announcement.

sources.name: 中央社（董事會排除黃仁勳回鍋）
中央社（財報上修展望與台積電親赴固樁）
經濟日報（Q3 營收破千億美元與 1,500 億庫藏股）
風傳媒（財報後治理與出口管制震盪）

text.zh-TW: 黃仁勳宣布辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，Colette Kress 出任臨時執行長。
text.en: Huang resigned as president, CEO and director; Colette Kress named interim CEO.

text.zh-TW: Nvidia 收跌 4.34%。
text.en: Nvidia closed down 4.34%.

text.zh-TW: 加權指數早盤漲逾 1,200 點。
text.en: TAIEX rose more than 1,200 points in early trade.

text.zh-TW: Nvidia 收跌 2.01%，市值收在 4 兆美元以下。
text.en: Nvidia closed down 2.01%, ending below a $4 trillion market value.

text.zh-TW: Nvidia 收跌 4.12%。截至此時，董事會尚未公布新任執行長人選。
text.en: Nvidia closed down 4.12%. The board had not yet named a permanent CEO.

time.zh-TW: 美西下午（台灣時間 11/18 凌晨）

text.zh-TW: Nvidia 公布 FY27 Q3 財報：營收 1,158 億美元（年增 103%）、資料中心營收 1,076 億美元（Vera Rubin 首季貢獻近 200 億美元），Q4 財測 1,300 億美元並加碼 1,500 億美元庫藏股；台積電領導團隊當週亦親赴輝達辦公室固樁。
text.en: Nvidia reported FY27 Q3 revenue of $115.8B (+103% YoY) and Data Center revenue of $107.6B (Vera Rubin contributing nearly $20B), guided Q4 to $130B, added a $150B buyback, and noted TSMC's leadership visited Nvidia's offices in person that week.

text.zh-TW: 針對黃仁勳曾表態若董事會需要願意回歸，董事會主席 Harvey C. Jones 明確表示董事會一致接受辭呈、無意恢復其執行長職務，正由獵頭公司 Heidrick & Struggles 協助尋覓正式執行長。
text.en: In response to Huang's offer to return if needed, Board Chair Harvey C. Jones stated the board unanimously accepted his resignation and has no intention of reinstating him, with Heidrick & Struggles leading the permanent CEO search.

text.zh-TW: 儘管財報盤後一度漲逾 3%，但受黃仁勳確定不回鍋的治理疑慮與利多出盡賣壓影響，Nvidia 開高走低，收跌 2.89%（150.96 美元）。
text.en: Reversing a 3%+ after-hours gain, Nvidia closed down 2.89% at $150.96 amid governance overhang and sell-the-news pressure after the board ruled out Huang's return.

text.zh-TW: Nvidia 續跌 3.30%，收在 145.98 美元。
text.en: Nvidia fell another 3.30% to close at $145.98.

text.zh-TW: 市場持續消化高層去職治理震盪、出口管制擴大與科技股修正，Nvidia 單日重挫 14.01%，收在 125.53 美元。
text.en: Weighed down by leadership-transition fallout, export-control scrutiny and a broader tech pullback, Nvidia plunged 14.01% to close at $125.53.

nextWatch.zh-TW: Heidrick & Struggles 主導的正式執行長遴選進度、出口管制與治理調查後續，以及 Vera Rubin 量產出貨對 Q4 營收（財測 1,300 億美元）的實際貢獻。
nextWatch.en: Progress on the Heidrick & Struggles CEO search, export-control and governance inquiries, and Vera Rubin volume shipments toward the $130B Q4 guidance.

what.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭任後董事會明確排除回鍋；Q3 營收首破千億美元，但股價於財報後連跌三日（11/20 重挫 14.01% 收 125.53 美元）。
what.en: After Huang's resignation, the board ruled out his return; Q3 revenue topped $115.8B, yet shares fell three straight days after earnings (-14.01% on Nov 20 to $125.53).

impact.zh-TW: Vera Rubin 正常量產、台積電高層親赴固樁，CUDA 與開發工具路線圖不受影響。
impact.en: Vera Rubin is in volume production, TSMC leadership visited to back the supply chain, and CUDA/developer roadmaps are unchanged.

action.zh-TW: 留意正式執行長人選與出口管制動向，技術選型無須調整。
action.en: Watch for the permanent CEO appointment and export-control updates; no stack changes needed.

title.zh-TW: Outlook 零時差漏洞遭實際利用
title.en: Outlook zero-day exploited in the wild

summary.zh-TW: 企業每天都在用的 Outlook 出現已遭利用的漏洞，可能外洩登入憑證。分數不高，卻是本月唯一已遭利用的微軟漏洞。
summary.en: Outlook, used across workplaces every day, has an exploited flaw that can leak sign-in credentials. Its score is modest, yet it's the only exploited Microsoft flaw this month.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟 11/10 例行更新修補 CVE-2026-124194，屬於 Outlook 欺騙漏洞，CVSS 6.5，微軟確認已遭利用。
facts.en: Microsoft's Nov 10 update fixed CVE-2026-124194, an Outlook spoofing flaw rated CVSS 6.5 that Microsoft confirmed is being exploited.

facts.zh-TW: 開啟特製的郵件檔案時，Outlook 可能在未警告的情況下連線到外部伺服器，外洩使用者的 NTLMv2 雜湊值。
facts.en: Opening a crafted message file can make Outlook connect to an outside server without warning, leaking the user's NTLMv2 hash.

facts.zh-TW: 美國 CISA 已列入已遭利用漏洞清單，要求聯邦機構於 11/24 前完成修補。
facts.en: CISA added it to its known-exploited list, giving federal agencies until Nov 24 to patch.

work.zh-TW: IT 部門可能推送 Office 更新並要求重新啟動 Outlook；建議確認更新確實已安裝到自己的電腦上。
work.en: IT may push Office updates and ask you to restart Outlook. Check that the update has actually landed on your machine.

work.zh-TW: 在修補完成前，對來路不明的附件或郵件檔案要特別小心。
work.en: Until it's patched, be especially careful with unexpected attachments and message files.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 資安媒體建議除了安裝更新，也考慮限制對外的 NTLM 驗證與連往不受信任主機的 SMB 連線。
securityFacts.en: Security outlets advise installing the update and also limiting outbound NTLM authentication and SMB connections to untrusted hosts.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 外洩的 NTLM 雜湊值常被用於中繼攻擊或離線破解，進一步取得帳號存取權。
securityPatterns.en: Leaked NTLM hashes are commonly used in relay attacks or cracked offline to gain account access.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大漏洞公開後，常出現假冒「緊急更新」的釣魚信，要求使用者點連結或下載檔案。
securityPatterns.en: After a major flaw goes public, fake "urgent update" emails asking users to click links or download files are common.

caveats.zh-TW: 我們未找到將當天跌幅與此漏洞或例行更新連結的報導，因此不推論兩者有因果關係。
caveats.en: We found no reporting linking that day's drop to this flaw or the update, so we draw no causal link.

caveats.zh-TW: 例行安全更新每月都會發布，通常不被市場視為重大事件。
caveats.en: Security updates ship every month and usually aren't treated as major market events.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股方面沒有直接相關的上市公司，因此不列出。
caveats.en: No directly related company is listed in Taiwan, so none is shown.

text.zh-TW: 微軟例行更新修補 CVE-2026-124194，確認已遭利用。
text.en: Microsoft's monthly update fixed CVE-2026-124194, confirmed as exploited.

text.zh-TW: CISA 列入已遭利用漏洞清單。
text.en: CISA added it to its known-exploited list.

text.zh-TW: 美國聯邦機構修補期限。
text.en: Deadline for US federal agencies to patch.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 是否出現更多攻擊報告，以及企業的修補進度。
nextWatch.en: Whether more attack reports surface, and how quickly organizations patch.

what.zh-TW: Outlook 漏洞遭實際利用，可能外洩登入憑證。
what.en: An exploited Outlook flaw can leak sign-in credentials.

impact.zh-TW: 開啟特製的郵件檔案就可能中招。
impact.en: Opening a crafted message file can be enough.

action.zh-TW: 確認 11 月的 Office 更新已安裝。
action.en: Make sure November's Office update is installed.

title.zh-TW: Microsoft 365 大規模斷線：Outlook、Teams、Copilot 受影響
title.en: Major Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot

summary.zh-TW: 美東時間 11/12 下午（台灣時間 11/13 凌晨）起，全球大量用戶無法收發信件。這正是軟體人最常遇到的情境：一個雲端服務停擺，連帶影響工作、資安與依賴它的 AI 整合。
summary.en: From the afternoon of Nov 12 US Eastern time, users worldwide couldn't send or receive email. It's the scenario engineers know best: one cloud service goes down and work, security and the AI integrations built on it go down with it.

facts.zh-TW: 美東時間 11/12 下午 1 點過後，Downdetector 上回報 Outlook 問題的美國用戶一度接近 13 萬人。
facts.en: Shortly after 1 p.m. ET on Nov 12, nearly 130,000 US users reported Outlook problems on Downdetector.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟起初表示問題出現在美洲，之後確認全球任何地區的 Microsoft 365 連線都可能受影響；Downdetector 統計波及 74 個國家和地區。
facts.en: Microsoft first pointed to the Americas, then confirmed Microsoft 365 connectivity could be affected in any region; Downdetector counted 74 countries and territories.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟表示，部分基礎設施在多個區域出現負載過高，可能是連線錯誤的原因；已暫停所有部署、轉移流量並重新啟動受影響的伺服器。
facts.en: Microsoft said elevated load on part of its infrastructure across regions was likely behind the errors; it paused all deployments, moved traffic and restarted affected servers.

facts.zh-TW: 部分伺服器恢復後，一旦流量回流又會再度無回應；微軟於美東時間 11/13 深夜將事件標示為服務已恢復。
facts.en: Some servers became unresponsive again once traffic returned. Microsoft marked the incident as service restored late on Nov 13 ET.

work.zh-TW: 受影響的服務包括 Exchange Online、Teams、SharePoint Online、Copilot 365、Defender XDR、Planner、To Do 與 Intune，等於企業日常協作工具大多停擺。
work.en: Affected services included Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, Copilot 365, Defender XDR, Planner, To Do and Intune: most of a company's daily collaboration stack.

work.zh-TW: 路透社報導，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的 AI 服務所使用的 Microsoft 365 連接器也受到波及。依賴 M365 的自動化流程與 AI 整合，可能在你沒察覺的情況下中斷。
work.en: Reuters reported the outage also hit Microsoft 365 connectors used by OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI services. Automations and AI integrations that depend on M365 may fail without you noticing.

work.zh-TW: 實務上可以先查看 Microsoft 365 服務狀態頁或系統管理中心的事件公告、改用備用溝通管道，並在服務恢復後確認是否有漏收的信件與排程。
work.en: In practice: check the Microsoft 365 status page or admin center incident notice, switch to a backup channel, and once service returns, check for missed mail and scheduled jobs.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 澳洲內政部長表示，微軟告知他們不認為這次斷線是網路攻擊造成的。
securityFacts.en: Australia's home affairs minister said Microsoft told him it didn't believe the outage was caused by a cyberattack.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 大型服務中斷期間，常出現假冒「帳號異常，請重新登入」或「服務已恢復，請驗證身分」的釣魚信。
securityPatterns.en: During major outages, phishing posing as "unusual account activity, sign in again" or "service restored, verify your identity" is common.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 員工可能改用個人信箱或未經核准的工具傳送公司資料，造成資料外洩風險。
securityPatterns.en: Staff may switch to personal email or unapproved tools to send company data, creating leak risks.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 同一週 Outlook 才剛修補一個已遭利用的零時差漏洞（見下方卡片），IT 部門應確認修補沒有因這次斷線而延誤。
securityPatterns.en: The same week, Outlook had just been patched for an exploited zero-day (see the card below); IT should make sure that patching wasn't delayed by the outage.

basis.en: Nov 12 close; outage began during trading
Nov 12 after hours, not a regular close

caveats.zh-TW: 同一天 Nvidia 宣布執行長辭任，牽動整個 AI 類股，也會影響微軟等大型科技股的走勢。
caveats.en: Nvidia announced its CEO's resignation the same day, moving the whole AI sector, including large tech stocks like Microsoft.

caveats.zh-TW: 斷線在收盤後仍未完全排除，後續股價反應有待觀察，本卡片會在下次更新時補上。
caveats.en: The outage wasn't fully resolved after the close; any later price reaction remains to be seen, and this card will be updated.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股方面沒有直接相關的上市公司，因此不列出。
caveats.en: No directly related company is listed in Taiwan, so none is shown.

text.zh-TW: 用戶回報量急升，Downdetector 上回報 Outlook 問題的美國用戶接近 13 萬人。
text.en: Reports spiked; nearly 130,000 US users reported Outlook problems on Downdetector.

text.zh-TW: 微軟讓部分伺服器恢復服務，但表示伺服器在流量回流後可能再次無回應。
text.en: Microsoft returned some servers to service but said they could become unresponsive again once traffic returned.

text.zh-TW: 微軟表示部分伺服器再度無回應，之後開始擴充容量以承接回流的流量。
text.en: Microsoft said some servers were unresponsive again, then began adding capacity for returning traffic.

text.zh-TW: 斷線延續到週五早上，微軟仍在修復中。
text.en: The outage stretched into Friday morning as Microsoft kept working on a fix.

text.zh-TW: 微軟將事件 MO1550821 與 EX1550543 標示為服務已恢復。
text.en: Microsoft marked incidents MO1550821 and EX1550543 as service restored.

text.zh-TW: 據 Wccftech 報導，微軟的初步事後檢討報告指出，原因是 Microsoft 365 網路閘道伺服器上一個先前未被發現的缺陷，源自 2026 年 7 月部署的更新；高峰時超過八成的閘道伺服器停止回應。
text.en: According to Wccftech, Microsoft's preliminary post-incident report traced the outage to a previously undetected defect on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers, introduced by an update deployed in July 2026; at the peak, more than 80% of gateway servers stopped responding.

text.zh-TW: 微軟預定今天發布最終事後檢討報告；截至本站查證時，尚未查到已發布。
text.en: Microsoft's final post-incident report is due today; we had not found it published at the time of our check.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 微軟預定 11/20 發布的最終事後檢討報告，以及後續的改善措施。
nextWatch.en: Microsoft's final post-incident report, due Nov 20, and the follow-up fixes.

topic.zh-TW: 斷線對微軟股價的影響
topic.en: How the outage affected Microsoft's stock

claim.zh-TW: 股價未受影響，當天小幅收高。
claim.en: Shares weren't affected and closed slightly higher.

verdict.zh-TW: 以收盤數據為準：微軟 11/12 收漲 0.36%（523.00 美元），沒有證據顯示斷線造成股價下跌。FX Leaders 的說法與數據不符。
verdict.en: We go by the close: Microsoft rose 0.36% to $523.00 on Nov 12, with no evidence the outage pushed it down. FX Leaders' claim doesn't match the data.

what.zh-TW: Microsoft 365 全球斷線，Outlook、Teams、Copilot 受影響。
what.en: A global Microsoft 365 outage hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot.

impact.zh-TW: 收發信件與依賴 Microsoft 365 的 AI 整合可能中斷。
impact.en: Email and AI integrations that depend on Microsoft 365 may fail.

action.zh-TW: 查看服務狀態頁，留意假冒「重新登入」的釣魚信。
action.en: Check the status page and watch for fake "sign in again" phishing.
